title: Refined OAuth Scopes for Transfer Config Management
summary: The BigQuery Data Transfer Service now recommends more granular `bigquery` OAuth scopes for creating and patching transfer configurations. The broader `cloud-platform` scope remains supported as an alternative.
details: The `create` and `patch` methods for `projects.locations.transferConfigs` and `projects.transferConfigs` have updated their recommended OAuth scopes. The primary scope has shifted from `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform` to `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/bigquery`. The `cloud-platform` scope is still listed as an alternative, ensuring backward compatibility. Developers are encouraged to adopt the more specific `bigquery` scope for improved security and least privilege.
